e: Joheirry Mola is crowned Miss World 2026 in Vietnam.
The United States imposes a 12.5% tariff on the Dominican Republic, citing the presence of alleged forced labor in the supply chain.
An Italian national is killed in a fire that destroys the Viva Dominicus Beach by Wyndham resort in Bayahibe and displaces 1,690 occupants.
An aircraft crashes near La Romana, killing its two American crew.
The Dominican Republic reaches an agreement with the United States to host migrants deported from the latter country.
A bus crashes in La Romana, killing two people.
A fault in a transmission line switch causes a nationwide blackout.
The decapitated bodies of four Haitian women are found near the southern section of the Dominican Republic–Haiti border.
